DVIET_COLOR_WORLDS.purpose: v6.0 Default Chromatic Law (color_world_polarity): 1 Cohesive Color World per video (55%-100% Primary Signature Hue + 0%-45% Pain/Contrast Hue + Dark/Light Polarity Flips). Eliminates 5+ bucket Rainbow Hue Soup.

semantic_6_hue_palette.purpose: Opt-in Legacy Multi-Hue System (activate ONLY when meta.color_policy == 'multi_hue_6' for explicit rainbow multi-color briefs).
semantic_6_hue_palette.warm_bg_counter_contrast_rule: When Plane-1 bokeh or speaker skin/lighting is warm amber/tungsten, prioritize cool semantic hues (mint #2DD4BF, cyan #38BDF8, violet #C084FC) so consecutive beats never wash out into monochrome yellow/orange.

gold.pair_best_over: Cool dark slate (#0B0D13) or neutral charcoal; avoid repeating over heavy warm tungsten skin

coral.pair_best_over: Dark charcoal (#0D0D0D / #111111) or high-contrast strike banners

mint.pair_best_over: Warm skin tones & 28%-luma tungsten studio bokeh (ideal cool counter-accent)

cyan.pair_best_over: Deep navy/slate (#0B0F19) or warm studio skin for crisp tech separation

violet_or_peach.pair_best_over: Use #C084FC Violet over warm skin/amber plates; use #FB923C Peach over cool slate/blue-gray plates

lime.pair_best_over: Dark matte surfaces (#0B0D13 / #111827) on proof & outcome beats

rules.preserve_vietnamese_nfc_and_glue: Normalize NFC first and obey data/text_vi.json compound glue so multi-hue spans never fracture a single bisyllabic Vietnamese word mid-line.
rules.wgpu_blend_guard: If parent text clip uses blend != 0, disable drop_shadow across all inline spans.

secondary_text_4_groups.purpose: Complete 4-Group Secondary Typography Catalog (S01..S18 + HUD micro-labels) replacing monotonous bottom karaoke with context-aware editorial choreography.

G1_lead_sub.label: Group 1 — Lead & Editorial Sub-Lines Paired with Hero Display (S01..S09)

s01_accordion_rollout_sub.spec: Grapheme-safe overlapping character slide (-34px -> 0, 32ms stagger) tucked cleanly above or below Hero

s02_boundary_pinch_sub.spec: Outer-boundaries-first inward pinch (24px -> 0 in 23f @ 60fps) framing centered Hero words

s03_stepup_underline_sub.spec: Bottom-center anchored 38% -> 100% step-up (+16px -> 0) with semantic accent underline

s04_baseline_rise_lead.spec: Cropped baseline rise (+58px -> 0) + 16px -> 0 Gaussian deblur for clean 40-48px lead-ins

s05_feather_wipe_lead.spec: 135px soft linear feather wipe (-90deg) introducing contemplative or luxury Hero statements

s06_swivel_3d_sub.spec: Crisp rot_y -90deg -> 0deg 3D swivel sub-badge synchronized with punchy Contrast/Proof kicks

s07_ghost_recede_stack.spec: 3-layer vertical receding ghost echo (100% / 38% / 14% alpha, 42px dy) emphasizing tension or repetition

s08_poetic_scatter_lead.spec: Soft tracking expansion (-0.04em -> +0.14em, non-script font only) for atmospheric or philosophical beats

s09_overlap_script_sub.spec: SVN-Aaron Script or Playfair Italic corner accent overlapping 15-25% of sans/condensed Hero edge

G2_quiet_bottom.label: Group 2 — Whisper 26pt & Quiet R209 Fixed-Slot Captions (S10..S12; S13 Banned)
G2_quiet_bottom.ruling: R209 (Y >= 1360 top-down), R30 (>= 3f last-word hold) & v6.0 Whisper Cap (<= 26-30pt when paired as 3rd zone)

s10_word_synced_fixed_slot_captions.spec: Pre-laid fixed-slot phrase at Y >= 1360 (zero horizontal reflow jump); spoken words pop from 48% muted -> 100% crisp white/semantic tint on exact word_tl timestamps

s11_conversational_2line.spec: 2-line text_vi.json compound-glued R209 top-down caption (Y in [1360, 1436]) with subtle -18px -> 0 rise and continuous hold micro-drift

s12_minimal_1line_quiet.spec: Single-line 32-38px quiet lower-third caption preserving maximum chest/hand gesture space on emotional beats

s12_whisper_26pt_sub.spec: Ultra-restrained 26pt (<=30pt) whisper lower-third at Y >= 1420 (72% #E2E8F0 opacity) — the ONLY G2 tier permitted as a 3rd active zone alongside Hero + G1/Card

explicitly_banned_default.s13_raw_karaoke_bounce: Banned unless user explicitly asks for karaoke. Bouncy neon word boxes compete with 4-Plane Z-Depth midground typography and pull viewer gaze away from eye_band.

G3_spatial_shoulder_arc.label: Group 3 — Asymmetric Wall Micro-Word Pops, Shoulder & Bridge-Swap Typography (S14..S17 + Wall Pop)

dviet_wall_microword_pop.spec: Signature @__dviet 7707 1-3 lowercase word pop (line_height 0.78 kiss mode, >=2.6x scale ratio) anchored into the open 2/3 negative wall space beside a 1/3 asymmetric speaker, optionally hopping across 2 spatial coordinates (dviet_two_point_wall_hop)

s14_shoulder_callout.spec: Asymmetric left/right shoulder callout (X=240 or X=840, Y=640..860) balancing off-center speaker framing with inline Color-World keyword

s15_tilted_counter_cluster.spec: -4deg to -7deg counter-tilted lockup where bottom sub-line enters -6f BEFORE the main Hero impact for kinetic whip anticipation

s16_bridge_anchor_swap.spec: Persistent anchor stem holds on V7 while right/bottom semantic complement swaps cleanly on V8 (+6f stagger) across parallel clauses

s17_circular_arc_sub_wrap.spec: Subtle curved/arched micro-subtitle framing upper shoulder/head silhouette halo without intersecting projected eye_band (mutex with mask_line_wipe)

G4_ui_micro_labels.label: Group 4 — Structured UI Micro-Labels, Active-Dim Pills & Viewfinder HUD (S18)

s18_typewriter_tech_tag.spec: JetBrains Mono grapheme-safe monospace tag (1.5 graphemes/frame + 8f cursor blink) for CLI, file, version, or timestamp cues

s18_active_dim_step_pills.spec: Multi-step horizontal/vertical pill strip: active step renders at 100% opacity + semantic hue, while previous/completed items automatically dim to 46% opacity

viewfinder_raw_card.spec: Minimal 4-corner bracket viewfinder + micro-metadata label signaling authentic raw camera / real case-study receipt

compact_glass_lock_badge.spec: Compact dark frosted pill badge locking a concise takeaway or metric unit without blocking A-roll posture

zdepth_flagship_personal_brand.rotation_recipe: Open with 2.5D Hero + G1 (s01/s04/s09); shift to G3 (s14/s15/s16) on asymmetric body beats; use G4 (s18_active_dim_step_pills) on 3-step frameworks; drop to quiet G2 (s10/s12) on pure A-roll breath.

tech_ai_saas_walkthrough.rotation_recipe: Anchor architecture/step beats with G4 (s18_typewriter_tech_tag, s18_active_dim_step_pills at 46% dim); pair key theses with G1 (s01/s03); use G2 s10 fixed-slot captions during fast spoken explanations.

sales_case_study_proof.rotation_recipe: Stamp authentic plates with G4 viewfinder_raw_card / compact_glass_lock_badge; punch contrasts with G3 s15_tilted_counter_cluster (-6f pre-lead) and G1 s02/s06; keep pure trust CTA on G2 s11.

intellectual_essay_and_story.rotation_recipe: Prioritize G2 s12_minimal_1line_quiet and clean room-tone silence; punctuate thesis turns sparingly with G1 s04/s05/s08 or a single G3 s14_shoulder_callout.

anti_clutter_mutex_rules: MAX_ZONES = 2 (v6.0 Spatial Density Cap): Never exceed 2 active overlay zones on any 100ms slice (3 allowed ONLY when G2 bottom caption is <= 26-30pt whisper s12_whisper_26pt_sub).
Card <-> Text Mutex (CARD_TEXT_COLLISION = 0): Never overlap any Hero, G1, G2, G3, or G4 text bounding box with an active card*/gfx*/prop* visual block.
Curated 1-3 Secondary Groups: Pick 1-3 cohesive secondary groups per video (never force 4/4 groups into one short) and leave >= 12% clean zero-overlay breathing frames.
Never use the exact same S01..S18 preset on more than 2 consecutive beats.

dviet_45582_empirical_typography_laws.corpus_scope: 19/19 @__dviet master videos (#01..#19, 45,582 native frames, 914.6s total duration)
dviet_45582_empirical_typography_laws.all_caps_em_dash_kicker_law: 0.0% ALL-CAPS em-dash/bullet kickers ('— ALL CAPS KICKER') exist in @__dviet across 45,582 frames. Replace mechanical corporate kickers with spoken lowercase micro-leads (>=2.6x scale contrast) or pure single-tier Hero breathing.
dviet_45582_empirical_typography_laws.pill_badge_restraint_law: < 1.5% of @__dviet frames carry frosted pill badges; reserve pills strictly for distinct technical specs, numbered step locks, or final CTA tokens — NEVER stamp decorative or duplicate badges.

swash_initial_hybrid.rule: Split display keyword into [0] + [1..n]: render index [0] ONLY when it is an unaccented ASCII Latin initial using mathematical/calligraphic swash glyphs (ℒ, 𝒩, 𝒬, ℋ, ℳ or SVN-Aaron Script / Playfair Swash at 1.28x-1.45x), and render slice [1..n] in 134/134 NFC-verified Be Vietnam Pro / Playfair Display Italic (padding_top_em >= 0.30, 0px stroke) so stacked Vietnamese diacritics never clip or tofu.
swash_initial_hybrid.fallback_when_index_0_accented: Render full [0..n] word in Playfair Display BoldItalic or Be Vietnam Pro ExtraBoldItalic with -0.03em tracking and 0.30em top padding.

syllable_stagger_60fps.law: Every sub-clause and Hero keyword inside kt01..kt12 MUST trigger on its exact words_tl.json spoken syllable onset (typical Δf = 8..16f @ 60fps); never pre-bake unspoken future rows 0.5s-4.8s early.

dynamic_contrast_ratio_35_35_30.law: Maintain ~35% Hero Kinetic Display : ~35% Whisper/Counterpoint Micro-Typography : ~30% Full/Midground 3D Studio Plates & Cranial Arcs (+ >=12-20% clean zero-overlay breathing frames) so typography breathes like music rather than hammering every sentence at equal volume.

kt01_kiss_editorial_2line.label: 2-Line Negative-Leading Editorial Kiss (0.78 Line-Height + Player-3 Air-Cushion)
kt01_kiss_editorial_2line.choreography_spec: Spoken lowercase sans lead (34-44px, #FAFAFA) glides up on lead_onset_f; oversized 0.78 kiss-leading Hero (84-124px, -0.035em tracking, 0px stroke) arrives on hero_onset_f (+8..14f @ 60fps) along Player-3 20f air-cushion Bezier.

kt02_feather_swash_overlap.label: Sub-Layer Feather=29 Masked Sans + Swash-Initial Serif/Script Overlap
kt02_feather_swash_overlap.choreography_spec: Tight ExtraBold base word enters at base_word_onset_f; bottom CSS linear-gradient alpha mask (Feather = 29px, 0px black stroke) softens lower 42% right as Swash-Initial ([0] ℒ/𝒩/𝒬/ℋ/ℳ + [1..n] Playfair/BeVietnam Italic) sweeps in on swash_accent_onset_f (+10..16f) with Glow 2.

kt03_per_word_nonlinear_bloom.label: Non-Linear Gap-Bridge Puzzle & Word-by-Word Halation Bloom
kt03_per_word_nonlinear_bloom.choreography_spec: Left and right flanking micro-words lock first to frame a deliberate negative-space pocket; when the stressed noun is spoken at center_hero_gap_onset_f, the oversized Hero drops into the center gap with 4f attack + 28f phosphor halation decay.

kt04_ghost_to_focus_stack.label: Optical Depth Defocus-to-Sharp Stack & Receding Ghost Echo
kt04_ghost_to_focus_stack.choreography_spec: Context line sits at 42% alpha + 6px optical defocus while foreground keyword snaps from 18px Gaussian blur + 1.06x scale to 0px razor focus over 12f on primary_focus_snap_f, flanked by 38%/14% receding depth echoes.

kt05_wall_spatial_counterpoint.label: Asymmetric 2/3 Negative-Wall Micro-Word Pop & Two-Point Spatial Hop
kt05_wall_spatial_counterpoint.choreography_spec: Designed for Left-1/3 or Right-1/3 asymmetric framing (or open upper corner): 1-3 lowercase words pop at coordinate A on hop_point_a_onset_f, then counter-balance at diagonal coordinate B (+110px dy) on hop_point_b_onset_f with subtle perspective(900px) wall tilt.

kt06_bridge_anchor_live_swap.label: Persistent Stem Anchor + Live Syllable Keyword Swap Across Clauses/Cuts
kt06_bridge_anchor_live_swap.choreography_spec: Compact invariant stem ('mình không', 'khóa chuẩn', 'bước') locks pixel-still across cuts (-2f..+11f bridge clearance safe) while right/bottom complement slot rotates cleanly through 2-3 spoken nouns via 8f vertical mask roll on exact word onsets.

kt07_telescoping_char_rollout.label: Grapheme-Safe Telescoping Character Rollout & Monospace Spec Tick
kt07_telescoping_char_rollout.choreography_spec: Unicode-NFC grapheme clusters (never splitting base vowel from tone/horn marks) telescope from -28px dx + -0.05em tracking into crisp optical kerning at 1.5-2.0f per grapheme, paired with optional single-occurrence monospace spec tag.

kt08_mist_evaporation_reveal.label: Sharp Anchor + Horizontal Gaussian Mist Evaporation Wipe
source_dviet_videos: #12 (7670574911680777492: f_02538..f_02584 'chữ' sharp + 'mờ ảo vl' horizontal feather mist)
kt08_mist_evaporation_reveal.choreography_spec: Left anchor word locks 100% tack-sharp on sharp_anchor_onset_f while right emotional/sensory phrase sweeps through a dual-layer SVG feGaussianBlur (0px -> 14px -> 0px crystallize or soft 6px atmospheric tail) on mist_sweep_onset_f.

kt09_strike_myth_laser_2phase.label: 2-Phase Myth-Bust Laser Strike -> Verified Truth Replacement
kt09_strike_myth_laser_2phase.choreography_spec: Phase 1: misconception phrase enters neutral #FAFAFA at myth_phrase_onset_f. Phase 2 (on negation syllable crimson_laser_strike_f): SVG crimson/ruby (#FF4D5E/#E11D48) 3px optical laser draws 0->100% across myth while dimming it to 42% and snapping verified truth below at truth_reframe_onset_f.

kt10_cursor_bars_pillar_gate.label: Center-Out Optical Cursor Pillar Gate & Precision Lock Reveal
kt10_cursor_bars_pillar_gate.choreography_spec: Two 2px jewel-tinted vertical optical cursor bars ignite at X=540 on gate_ignite_f and part symmetrically along cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) over 18f on pillar_part_onset_f, unmasking crisp architectural/clinical/tech Hero typography via CSS clip-path.

kt11_cranial_svg_arc_or_tilt.label: Curved Cranial Halo SVG <textPath> Arc OR Corner-Pinned 3D Wall Tilt
kt11_cranial_svg_arc_or_tilt.choreography_spec: Renders an authentic SVG <path> + <textPath> crown halo arching >= 65px CLEAR above hair_top_y (0.00% Cranial Lock violation) with progressive startOffset/mask reveal on arc_sweep_onset_f, OR a perspective(900px) rotateY(-14deg) rotateZ(-4deg) planar wall lockup.

kt12_whisper_or_directional_echo.label: 26pt Quiet Whisper Rail OR Stepped Upward-Right Directional Glow Echo
source_dviet_videos: #16 (7688934517783989524: f_00420..f_00960 quiet 1/5 bottom gold italic whisper)
#19 (7707653827016674580: f_01352..f_01373 'lặp lại' + 2 stepped upward-right glow echoes)
kt12_whisper_or_directional_echo.choreography_spec: Dual-mode dynamic contrast breather: Mode A renders ultra-clean 26-30pt R209 fixed-slot whisper words lighting from 46% -> 100% on exact phrase_word_onsets_f; Mode B renders Video #19's flat geometric keyword firing 2 stepped upward-right (+18px, -16px / +36px, -32px) directional blur glow echoes on echo_step_1_f/2_f.

caption_y_by_layout_v74.scope: profile dviet only; the older whisper y=1590 (83 %) and minimal captions y=1440 (75 %) stay the default for every other profile

script_accent_whole_word_v74.rule: Under profile dviet, role script_accent renders the WHOLE keyword (for example 'chuyên nghiệp', 'overthinking', 'Lưu lại') in a script face that carries the Vietnamese diacritics. The swash_initial_hybrid law ([0] swash + [1..n] NFC italic) is retained only for this role, and is the fallback when the script face lacks glyphs for the word.
script_accent_whole_word_v74.glyph_check: scripts/tools/dviet_text.py warns (never errors) when the font is missing

keyword_caps_small_yellow_v74.rule: A small yellow ALL-CAPS keyword may sit inside a caption (for example 'MÁY PHÁT NHẠC 3', 'LÀ OKE'). This is NOT the banned em-dash ALL-CAPS kicker above a hero (0.0 % of @__dviet frames): it is inline, at most one per caption, accent colour from dviet_style_tokens.json.

rgb_fringe_text_native.description: Native FilmCraft rgb_split (Linear, horizontal) on a text clip, hold-keyed over 3 frames from the offsets of glitch_rgb_split ([14, -10, 5, 0] px, here abs values: the sign/direction of `amount` is unverified). Does not replace glitch_rgb_split (the plate/engine recipe); mutex_with and nfc_guardrails (horizontal only, max 14) are inherited.
